def check_spoken_cards():
    if True:
        if True:
            _desk_player_narrations=[]
            _desk_card_sentences=set()
            for _desk_action in ("BUY", "HOLD", "SELL"):
                for _desk_index in range(3):
                    _desk_text=_d3_desk_narr(_desk_action, _desk_index)
                    _desk_player_narrations.append(_desk_text)
                    _desk_sentences=[
                        re.sub(r"\s+", " ", sentence.strip().lower())
                        for sentence in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", _desk_text)
                        if sentence.strip()
                    ]
                    _desk_internal_duplicates=sorted({
                        sentence for sentence in _desk_sentences
                        if _desk_sentences.count(sentence) > 1
                    })
                    if _desk_internal_duplicates:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            f"Transfer Decision Desk {_desk_action} card {_desk_index + 1} "
                            "repeats a full sentence: "
                            + " | ".join(_desk_internal_duplicates[:3])
                        )
                    _desk_card_sentences.update(_desk_sentences)
            if len(_desk_player_narrations) != 9 or len(set(_desk_player_narrations)) != 9:
                raise RuntimeError("Transfer Decision Desk must contain 9 unique spoken player narrations.")

if True:
    async def _d3_transfer_audio(profile):
        """Join measured PCM sections and true silent card windows on one timeline."""
        import math
        import wave
        plan = globals().get("TRANSFER_DESK_NARRATION_PLAN") or {}
        if plan.get("version") != "DESK_3_SPOKEN_2_SILENT_V1" or len(plan.get("sections", [])) != 3:
            raise RuntimeError("Transfer Desk audio needs the revised narration plan; rerun Cell 14B.")
        sample_rate = 48000
        # PCM/segment assembly belongs in local scratch storage. Cell 21 only
        # permits completed MP3 files in the published Drive MP3 directory.
        import shutil
        work = Path(globals().get("AUDIO_WORK_DIR", "/content/FPL_VORTEX_DAY3_WORK/audio")) / "transfer_desk_segments"
        work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        legacy_work = AUDIO / "transfer_desk_segments"
        if legacy_work.is_dir() and legacy_work.resolve() != work.resolve():
            # Preserve intermediate bytes from older runs while removing them
            # from the published-output tree before Cell 21 audits it.
            shutil.move(str(legacy_work), str(work / "legacy_drive_segments"))
        pcm_path = work / "assembled.pending.wav"
        sample_cursor = 0
        all_words, spoken_sections, windows, silent_intervals, zones = [], [], [], [], {}
        with wave.open(str(pcm_path), "wb") as output:
            output.setnchannels(1)
            output.setsampwidth(2)
            output.setframerate(sample_rate)
            for section_index, section in enumerate(plan["sections"] + [{"action": "CLOSE", "text": plan["closing"]}]):
                action = section["action"]
                text = vx_full_word_narration(section["text"], context=f"Transfer Desk {action}", expand_player_context=False)
                info = await vx_synthesize_audio(work / f"{action.lower()}.mp3", text, profile)
                decoded = work / f"{action.lower()}.wav"
                subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
                                "-i", str(info["audio"]), "-vn", "-ac", "1", "-ar", str(sample_rate),
                                "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", str(decoded)], check=True, capture_output=True)
                with wave.open(str(decoded), "rb") as source:
                    frame_count = source.getnframes()
                    frames = source.readframes(frame_count)
                offset = sample_cursor / sample_rate
                local_words = []
                for word in info["words"]:
                    shifted = dict(word)
                    start, duration = float(word["start"]), float(word.get("duration", 0.0))
                    if not math.isfinite(start + duration) or start < 0 or duration < 0:
                        raise RuntimeError(f"Transfer Desk {action} has invalid word boundaries")
                    shifted["start"] = start + offset
                    local_words.append(shifted)
                if not local_words:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"Transfer Desk {action} produced no spoken word boundaries")
                # Some containers omit a trailing silent fraction included in the TTS clock.
                last_word_end = max(float(word["start"]) + float(word.get("duration", 0.0)) for word in info["words"])
                padded_frames = max(frame_count, math.ceil(last_word_end * sample_rate))
                output.writeframesraw(frames)
                if padded_frames > frame_count:
                    output.writeframesraw(b"\x00\x00" * (padded_frames - frame_count))
                sample_cursor += padded_frames
                end = sample_cursor / sample_rate
                all_words.extend(local_words)
                spoken_sections.append(text)
                if action == "CLOSE":
                    closing_at = offset
                    continue
                zones[action.lower()] = offset
                players = section["players"]
                if len(players) != 3 or len(section["silent_cards"]) != 2:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"Transfer Desk {action} must contain three narrated and two silent cards")
                starts = [offset] + [float(vx_phrase_time(local_words, player["anchor"], required=True,
                                      context=f"Transfer Desk {action} player {player['player_id']}")) for player in players[1:]]
                # Validate the first player cue too; its card is already visible during the section introduction.
                vx_phrase_time(local_words, players[0]["anchor"], required=True, context=f"Transfer Desk {action} first player")
                if starts != sorted(starts) or len(set(starts)) != 3 or starts[-1] >= end:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"Transfer Desk {action} timing is out of order")
                for index, player in enumerate(players):
                    settle = starts[index + 1] if index + 1 < len(starts) else end
                    windows.append(dict(player, action=action, start=starts[index], settle=settle,
                                        exit_at=settle - min(.34, (settle-starts[index])*.2), narrated=True))
                seconds = float(section["silent_card_seconds"])
                if not math.isfinite(seconds) or seconds <= 0:
                    raise RuntimeError("Transfer Desk silent-card duration is invalid")
                silent_frames = round(seconds * sample_rate)
                for player in section["silent_cards"]:
                    start = sample_cursor / sample_rate
                    output.writeframesraw(b"\x00\x00" * silent_frames)
                    sample_cursor += silent_frames
                    settle = sample_cursor / sample_rate
                    windows.append(dict(player, action=action, start=start, settle=settle,
                                        exit_at=settle-min(.34, seconds*.2), narrated=False))
                    silent_intervals.append({"i": player["i"], "start": start, "end": settle})
        target = AUDIO / "05_transfer_decision_desk.mp3"
        pending = work / "assembled.pending.mp3"
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-i", str(pcm_path),
                        "-c:a", "libmp3lame", "-b:a", "192k", str(pending)], check=True, capture_output=True)
        duration = float(vx_media_duration(pending))
        if len(windows) != 15 or len(silent_intervals) != 6 or not math.isfinite(duration) or duration <= closing_at:
            raise RuntimeError("Transfer Desk assembled timeline is incomplete")
        _d3_publish_audio(pending, target)
        text = "\n\n".join(spoken_sections)
        return {"audio": str(target), "duration": duration, "words": all_words, "script": text,
                "display_text": vx_full_word_display(text, context="Transfer Desk display"),
                "tts_mood": "analysis", "tts_profile": profile,
                "sync_cues": {"version": plan["version"], "windows": windows, "zones": zones,
                              "closing_at": closing_at, "silent_intervals": silent_intervals}}
